newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Martinair Guangzhou cargo service delayed.
newsitem.headline: Martinair Guangzhou cargo service delayed.

text.p: Martinair NV's planned twice weekly service to Guangzhou in southern China, planned for October 1, is being delayed due to "administrative problems" a spokesman for the company said.
Udo Buys, Martinair press officer told Reuters in a telephone interview that the planned launch date for the new service will slip.

"We should have started October 1 but I have just heard that there are administrative problems and that the date will slip. I don't think we will be as late as November, but I cannot give a specific day for the start-up of the service."
He said he believed the airline, which is 50 pct owned by KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV, may be encountering difficulties in setting up its administration within China.

In February this year, Martinair said it would launch a twice weekly full freighter service between Amsterdam and Guangzhou, which was to have made it the first European airline to offer a scheduled all-cargo service to Guangzhou.
Martinair's plans followed agreement between the respective Dutch and Chinese governments. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
